purpose: SP15 stages 2 and 3 (Q2 for the E upstroke, graded): hold the function (B3 genome and flags), change the input by a graded amount. The dendritic and apical membrane area (cm, g_pas and the distributed Ih density together) is scaled 1.5, 2 and 3 times at fixed geometry. Stage 2 asks at 200 pA (closed: every dose silenced the cell); stage 3 asks at 310 pA, where the model and the human both fire ten spikes. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-12-h01-topographic-strategy.md (stage 2 and 3 addenda).
executor_note: Runs on the Vast.ai box (NEURON 9.0.2) from a clean worktree of this branch; the main box checkout carries another session's edits.
image: braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 (reference image; not used by the local executor)
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed and is not an input. Stage 2 uses sweep 56 (200 pA), stage 3 sweep 53 (310 pA); the upstroke is read from spike 1.
evaluation: One dose at one sweep = one evaluation; stage 2 spends three, stage 3 four.

base_candidate.note: The stage-1 control: B3 flags at nseg factor 1 without soma-current probes. Its run q2-nseg1-sweep56 is the x1 point of this series (653.3 V/s, count 4, first spike 126.5 ms, threshold -57.4 mV) and is not rerun.

2.title: Stage 2: dendritic and apical membrane area x1.5, x2 and x3 at sweep 56, nseg factor 1
2.prediction: If the upstroke lives in the function (somatic sodium), the spike-1 maximum rise stays within max(3 x the mesh deviation, 10 percent) of the x1 control, that is within 166 V/s of 653 V/s, at every dose that still spikes. If it lives in the input (cable load), the maximum rise falls monotonically with the dose and leaves that band before the cell stops spiking. Reported, not banded: the 200 pA count, the first-spike time, the threshold, the post-spike level and the onset capacitance at each dose.
2.rejection: Every dose that leaves the band also fails to spike (no reading, as in stage 1), or the maximum rise moves without a monotone trend across the three doses (the dose is not acting through the cable load).
2.unchanged: All B3 flags of q2-nseg1.candidate.json; nseg factor 1; CVode 1e-10; recorded command plus bias; stop 2100 ms; no soma-current probes; the geometry, the axial resistance and every soma mechanism.
2.outcome: CLOSED 2026-09-12: every dose silenced the cell at 200 pA (counts 4, 0, 0, 0); registered no-reading outcome. Levels in h01-e-cable-load/dose-levels.json.

3.title: Stage 3: the same three doses plus the x1 control at sweep 53 (310 pA), nseg factor 1
3.prediction: The x1 control at nseg 1 reproduces the nseg-9 spike-1 maximum rise 639.1 V/s within 10 percent. If the upstroke lives in the function, the maximum rise stays within max(3 x that mesh deviation, 10 percent of the control) at every dose that still spikes; if it lives in the input, it falls monotonically and leaves that band while the cell is still spiking. The human value at this input is 347.7 V/s with ten spikes; the model gives ten spikes too, so the count is comparable across the series. Reported, not banded: count, first spike, threshold, plateau level, onset capacitance and input resistance at each dose.
3.rejection: Every dose that leaves the band also fails to spike (the stage-1 and stage-2 no-reading case), or the departure is not monotone across the three doses.
3.unchanged: All B3 flags of q2-nseg1.candidate.json; nseg factor 1; CVode 1e-10; recorded command plus bias; stop 2100 ms; no soma-current probes; the geometry, the axial resistance and every soma mechanism.
3.outcome: CLOSED 2026-09-12 as CONTROL INVALID: the nseg-1 x1 control fires 72 times and then falls silent at 310 pA (plateau -74 mV after 400 ms) against the nseg-9 reference of 10 steady spikes at -64.6 mV; the x2 dose enters depolarisation block at -28 mV. The spike-1 upstroke band held (9.0 percent mesh deviation), which is why a one-number control check passed a control that does not reproduce the response. The scorer now requires the control to reproduce the reference spike count.

4.title: Stage 4: the same three doses plus the x1 control at sweep 53 (310 pA), nseg factor 9
4.prediction: The x1 control at nseg 9 reproduces the reference response: 10 spikes with spike-1 maximum rise 639.1 V/s and a stable interspike level near -64.6 mV. If the upstroke lives in the function, the maximum rise then stays within max(3 x the control's deviation from 639.1, 10 percent of the control) at every dose that still fires a comparable train; if it lives in the input, it falls monotonically and leaves that band while the cell still fires. The human at this input gives 10 spikes with 347.7 V/s, so the model and human counts are comparable at x1.
4.rejection: The control does not reproduce the reference count of 10 (control invalid, as in stage 3); or every dose that leaves the band also stops firing a comparable train (no reading, as in stages 1 and 2); or the departure is not monotone.
4.unchanged: All B3 flags of q2-nseg1.candidate.json; nseg factor 9; CVode 1e-10; recorded command plus bias; stop 2100 ms; no soma-current probes; the geometry, the axial resistance and every soma mechanism.
4.reading_aid: The human's own passive load is 1.13x B3's conductance and 1.03x its capacitance (h01-e-cable-load/human-passive-load.json); the dose series gives the slope of the upstroke against load, so the reading is whether a 1.13x load change can cover the 290 V/s human-model gap.
